761320101.text: Phew... It was no problem for you in the end! That should take care of things, right?

761320102.text: Alert! Main Control Hall Defender Core destruction confirmed. Initiating self-destruct mode.

761320103.text: All personnel, please evacuate immediately. Initiating countdown...

761320104.text: Seriously!? This base has gone crazy! It's trying to take us down with it... What should we do?

761320105.text: What if some really important intel gets destroyed!?

761320107.text: Huh? What orbital coordinates? Whoa! Our mystery kuuhenki's back!

761320109.text: What are you doing? Will giving it the coordinates stop the base from self-destructing!?

761320111.text: What are the coordinates? Don't panic, don't panic, let Paimon think!

761320113.text: Paimon remembers now... There were three symbols! The <color=#00E1FFFF>simplest-looking</color> one was first!

761320117.text: The second symbol had a <color=#00E1FFFF>super complicated</color> shape!

761320501.text: We've never been here before. Where is this, exactly?

761320502.text: Huh? Look! That person over there...

761320504.text: Why's she here? Paimon thought she'd be at Silvermoon Hall...

761320505.text: Heh, funny how life works sometimes. Let's go over and say hi!

761320201.text: Hey! Columbina! Where are you going!?

761320202.text: Agh, she's gone too far out. She can't hear us.

761320203.text: But what's she doing here? Does she have something to do?

761320204.text: Let's follow her and take a look.

761320205.text: Yeah. Paimon doesn't think she'll run into any trouble, but better safe than sorry.

761320701.text: This vessel is bound for lunar orbit.

761320801.text: Whoa, we blasted off for real! Paimon was expecting a regular ol' vanilla adventure... but here we are flying to the moon!

761320802.text: Hey! You! Tell us what's going on, will ya!? What sort of trouble has Columbina gotten into?

761320805.text: Say something, or I'll throw you into space.

761320807.text: We definitely heard you speak just now, right? No, wait... You spoke through the base's systems, didn't you?

761320811.text: Then how about... we take a look around this ship? Let's see if we can find something to help you talk.

761321001.text: According to the route map, this should be the Main Control Hall, right?

761321002.text: Hey! You! The one pretending to be Columbina! Come out right now!

761321003.text: Alert! Intruder detected in Main Control Hall. Activating defense measures.

761321004.text: Wah! Sorry! Wrong address, we were looking for someone else!

761320401.text: This place looks like some sort of ruins...

761320402.text: Huh. What are those rings? Looks like they've fallen onto the ground or something.

761320404.text: Is that so? In that case, could this glowing sign next to it... be a manual, maybe?

761320407.text: Oh, darn it! Paimon triggered some kinda intruder alarm!

761320409.text: Power transmission has ceased. Please head to the <color=#00E1FFFF>generator room</color> to activate backup power!

761320410.text: Oh, so it's just out of power! Gah, Paimon almost jumped outta her skin!

761320411.text: Reminds me of you when you're hungry, you know?

761320412.text: What? C—C'mon, Paimon's way classier than that!

761320413.text: Let's go check this generator room out first.

761320415.text: Ohh, right! If Columbina came here to do something, she'd totally need to turn on the power first.

761320416.text: Right, and we might find her there.

761321501.text: Huh. This thing... doesn't really look very mechanical, but given where we found it, it must be the key to getting the power on somehow.

761321502.text: But Paimon doesn't see how that's supposed to work...

761321503.text: It doesn't look like the power's been turned on yet.

761321504.text: Yeah, and that's super weird. Do you think Columbina's already been here? Maybe she discovered that the power wouldn't start, and went to look for a solution elsewhere?

761321505.text: Hmm. Y'know what? Let's give this thing a try anyway. Maybe we can find out what's going on...

subQuests.subQuestName: Find a way to activate the energy mechanisms
Find a way to activate the energy mechanisms

761321204.text: Paimon guessed as much... There's gotta be something else to this. Columbina must have run into this problem and then gone to look somewhere else... Huh!?

761321205.text: C—Columbina!? Thank goodness, we finally found you!

761321206.text: Hehe... Surprised to see us? We were worried you might be in trouble, so we followed you here.

761321213.text: ...What's wrong? Are you trying to use telepathy, like Nicole? Just so you know, we aren't hearing anything!

761321216.text: Okay, now you're starting to worry Paimon...

761321217.text: Is someone threatening you!? If that's the case, just blink...

761321220.text: Do you want us to activate this?

761321221.text: Paimon's not sure what's going on, but it looks like Columbina wants us to activate this device. We should give it another try!

subQuests.subQuestName: Find a way to activate the energy mechanisms

761321901.text: Awesome! The energy channels are clear! How did you do that, Columbina?

761321905.text: We'd better catch up with her.

761321401.text: Calculating celestial orbits. Please select the Trilune coordinates you wish to view.

761321403.text: Wait, so this device is used to work out where the moons are?

761321404.text: Calculating celestial orbits. Please select the Trilune coordinates you wish to view.

761321406.text: Connection lost... Failed to locate target...

761321412.text: Whoa, it actually found the Frost Moon... But why would they need those coordinates anyways?

761321413.text: Frost Moon coordinates located. Base engineering blueprints and Main Control Hall route map have been transmitted.

761321414.text: Ooh! These look like schematics! Whatever these are showing, it looks super awesome!

761321415.text: Do you wish to obtain the route map?

761321417.text: Please proceed to the Main Control Hall for moon landing preparations.

761321419.text: Columbina... is this place used for getting to the moon!?

761321420.text: (But Columbina has taken me to the Frost Moon before... Why would she need this device?)

761321421.text: (And the power she just gave me is completely new. I've never seen her use it before...)

761321423.text: Oh! The door opened! This leads to the Main Control Hall, right? Columbina, is that where you want us to go?

761321425.text: Columbina, can you hold out your hand?

761321427.text: Place it in mine, just like we do in Silvermoon Hall.

761321431.text: Waaah! What's going on? Columbina turned into a black kuuhenki!

761321411.text: Connection lost... Failed to locate target...

subQuests.subQuestName: Enter the main control hall to search for the black kuuhenki
The lunar shuttle has been launched...

761321101.text: Huh? Is this escape pod broken?

761321104.text: Huh? She's here too? Does that mean there's something useful inside? But how do we get it out?

761321105.text: While you think, the kuuhenki slips into the escape pod. A moment later, she returns — carrying an item.

761321108.text: Whoa, is that your voice? You can talk through this thing?

761321109.text: Mmhmm... Power of the ancient moons... transmit messages...

761321110.text: Huh? That sounds a lot like Phlogiston... Could this be dragon technology?

761321114.text: ...Why do you pant so much when you talk?

761321115.text: It looks like the base and the spaceship were made by the dragons.

761321116.text: No wonder we ran into their Secret Source Automatons back there!

761321117.text: But what does this all have to do with Columbina? Why did you turn into her?

761321119.text: Did she run into trouble and send you to get help?

761321123.text: ...Can you... take it from the top and tell us the whole story? What exactly is going on?

761321124.text: Columbina... rescued me... on the moon...

761321125.text: Huh? She rescued you? So she hasn't sent us a plea for help?

761321127.text: Then why did you tell us to get on this spaceship?

761321128.text: I wanted to... go back to the moon...

761321130.text: Oh no... In that case... what does that make us?

761321131.text: People who came along of their own accord...

761321132.text: No, no, how could this happen? We're not that clueless, are we?

761321133.text: Hey, you! You're leaving something out, aren't you? You said Columbina rescued you. That means you were in danger!

761321135.text: Not what this time? Not wrong? Not right?

761321138.text: ...Ugh, this is really starting to get on Paimon's nerves...

761321142.text: When I woke up... I was very weak... I forgot... many things...

761321143.text: She took me to... a place of healing...

761321145.text: Oh? Did Columbina tell you to stay there and rest? Then why did you come here?

761321150.text: How could you forget something like that!?

761321151.text: So your home is on the moon?

761321152.text: Oh, right! You keep talking about going back to the moon... So you're not a local kuuhenki from Teyvat?

761321153.text: Yes... I belong on... the moon...

761321156.text: Well, that explains it! Paimon's got it all figured out now.

761321157.text: Columbina wasn't in trouble... She just picked this kuuhenki up while strolling around the moon and sent her to Silvermoon Hall.

761321158.text: But our girl's got a little problem... she either doesn't talk at all, or has to pant her way to the finish line...

761321159.text: And now the two of us have gone whoosh and flown right out of Teyvat, like a couple of silly Anemo Slimes hit by an arrow!

761320301.text: This vessel is about to enter lunar orbit. Please select a landing site.

761320302.text: There are so many landing sites, but they all have super weird names... Which one should we pick?

761320306.text: Connection established. Confirm landing thruster initiation?

761320308.text: Whoa! Are we getting ready to land?
